title: Outside and Inside Character Cards
purpose: Help children distinguish visible details from character shown through actions.
body_markdown:
# Outside and Inside Character Cards

## Visible details

- Height
- Clothing colour
- Hair style

## Character actions

- Tells the truth
- Keeps a promise
- Includes someone
- Asks for help when something is wrong

## Teacher note

Only God knows the heart fully. Humans can evaluate actions without ranking bodies or claiming perfect knowledge of motives.
